facts.fact: The Bank of Botswana says the Electronic Payment Services (Amendment) Regulations, 2026, in effect since 2 April 2026, set out the entities that may be licensed to offer electronic payment services and the licensing and market-entry requirements.

The Bank of Botswana says the Electronic Payment Services (Amendment) Regulations, 2026, in effect since 2 April 2026, include market conduct obligations and provisions on dormant and unclaimed funds to enhance consumer protection.

BWA.note: Money or value transfer services are mentioned only as a sector, with no corridor or channel.
Nothing on government payments to people.

facts.fact: The Bank of Botswana says the 2026 Electronic Payment Services regulations permit interest-bearing e-money balances and apply operating limits to payment receipts in account-based services, and urges the public to use licensed payment service providers.
